## busted check
goal is to test busted csv column info to make sure we're 
correctly extracting from what was in the original hyphy (busted) json
```{r, busted checkin}

# jf<- "FMO1_BUSTED.json"
# J <- fromJSON(jf, simplifyVector = FALSE)
# csv <- read.csv("fmo1_bustedEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
jf<- "TSPO_BUSTED.json"
J <- fromJSON(jf, simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("tspo_bustedEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

##json slots as ground truth
U <- J$fits[["Unconstrained model"]][["Rate Distributions"]][["Test"]]
Cm <- J$fits[["Constrained model"]][["Rate Distributions"]][["Test"]]
Uom <- sapply(U, `[[`, "omega")
Upr <- sapply(U, `[[`, "proportion")
Com <- sapply(Cm, `[[`, "omega")
Cpr <- sapply(Cm, `[[`, "proportion")
lrt <- J[["test results"]][["LRT"]]
pval <- J[["test results"]][["p-value"]]
pj <- as.integer(names(J[["data partitions"]]))
##gene token from JSON's own input path
gene_exp <- sub("_.*", "", basename(J[["input"]][["file name"]]))
##float rounding unsafe for exact equality on long decimals
tol <- 1e-8

##8 gene lvl numeric cols
num <- list(lrt = lrt, pval = pval,
            omega_purifying = Uom[[1]], omega_neutral = Uom[[2]], omega_positive = Uom[[3]],
            proportion_purifying = Upr[[1]], proportion_neutral = Upr[[2]], proportion_positive = Upr[[3]]
            )

##fits_*,parse embedded json in every row, match omega and prop vectors to the json model
fits_ok <- function(col, om, pr) {
  all(vapply(csv[[col]], function(s) {
    P <- fromJSON(s)
    isTRUE(all(abs(P$omega - om) < tol)) && isTRUE(all(abs(P$proportion - pr) < tol))},
    logical(1))
    )
  }
##branches, every row's set v json tested branches at that partition
branch_ok <- all(vapply(seq_len(nrow(csv)),
                        function(i) {
                          p  <- as.character(csv$partition[i])
                          tb <- unlist(J$tested[[p]])
                          setequal(fromJSON(csv$branches[i]), names(tb)[tb == "test"])
                          },
                        logical(1))
                 )
##codon range,every rows range v json coverage min-max at that partition
range_ok <- all(vapply(seq_len(nrow(csv)), 
                       function(i) {
                         p <- as.character(csv$partition[i])
                         cov <- as.integer(unlist(J[["data partitions"]][[p]][["coverage"]]))
                         identical(sprintf("%d-%d", min(cov), max(cov)), csv$partition_codon_range[i])
              }, logical(1))
              )

##per-partition display values
tb_ct <- vapply(names(J[["data partitions"]]),
                  function(p){ 
                    tb<-unlist(J$tested[[p]])
                    sum(tb=="test")
                    }, integer(1)
                  )
cov_rng <- vapply(names(J[["data partitions"]]),
                  function(p){
                    cv<-as.integer(unlist(J[["data partitions"]][[p]][["coverage"]]))
                    sprintf("%d-%d",min(cv),max(cv)) 
                    }, character(1)
                  )

##one does-it-match row per busted col (14), csv value v json
cols <- c("gene", names(num), "fits_constrained_test", "fits_unconstrained_test",
          "branches", "partition", "partition_codon_range")
json_v <- c(gene_exp, as.character(unlist(num)),
            paste0("w=", toString(round(Com, 4))), paste0("w=", toString(round(Uom, 4))),
            paste0(paste(tb_ct, collapse = ", "), " tested"),
            toString(pj), toString(cov_rng))
csv_v <- c(csv$gene[1], vapply(names(num), function(k) as.character(csv[[k]][1]), character(1)),
           paste0("w=", toString(round(fromJSON(csv$fits_constrained_test[1])$omega, 4))),
           paste0("w=", toString(round(fromJSON(csv$fits_unconstrained_test[1])$omega, 4))),
           paste0(paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(csv)), function(i) length(fromJSON(csv$branches[i])),
                               integer(1)), collapse = ", "), " tested"),
           toString(csv$partition), toString(csv$partition_codon_range))
match_v<- c(all(csv$gene == gene_exp),
            vapply(names(num), function(k) all(abs(num[[k]] - csv[[k]]) < tol), logical(1)),
            fits_ok("fits_constrained_test", Com, Cpr),
            fits_ok("fits_unconstrained_test", Uom, Upr),
            branch_ok,
            setequal(csv$partition, pj) && length(csv$partition) == length(pj),
            range_ok)

print(data.frame(column = cols, json = json_v, csv = csv_v, match = match_v),
      row.names = FALSE)

##clear on 14 busted-eh cols

```



## gard checkin
```{r, gard checkin}

###jf <- "FMO1_GARD.json"
##J <- fromJSON(jf, simplifyVector = FALSE)
###csv <- read.csv("fmo1_gardEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

jf <- "TSPO_GARD.json"
J <- fromJSON(jf, simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("tspo_gardEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

##gene token from json in-path
gene_exp <- sub("_.*", "", basename(J[["input"]][["file name"]]))
###src json filename
file_exp <- basename(jf) 
tol <- 1e-8

###indexing and organizing Json ref vals
jnum <- c(
  number_of_sequences = J$input[["number of sequences"]],
  number_of_sites = J$input[["number of sites"]],
  baselineScore = J[["baselineScore"]],
  bestModelAICc = J[["bestModelAICc"]],
  singleTreeAICc = J[["singleTreeAICc"]],
  potentialBreakpoints = J[["potentialBreakpoints"]]
  )
bps <- as.numeric(unlist(list(J$breakpointData[["0"]]$bps, J$breakpointData[["1"]]$bps)))
ibp <- as.numeric(unlist(J$improvements[["0"]]$breakpoints))
dA <- as.numeric(J$improvements[["0"]]$deltaAICc)
sbps <- J$siteBreakPointSupport
jp <- as.integer(names(sbps))
nwk <- J$trees[["0"]]$newickString
tips <- regmatches(nwk, gregexpr("[^(),:;]+(?=:)", nwk, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
tips <- tips[grepl(paste0("^", gene_exp, "_"), tips)]
parts <- names(J$breakpointData)
json_rng <- vapply(parts, function(p){ 
  bp<-as.integer(unlist(J$breakpointData[[p]]$bps))
  sprintf("%d-%d",min(bp),max(bp)) }, 
  character(1)
  )
ord <- match(as.integer(parts), csv$partition)

##match rows, parse an compare
m_num <- vapply(names(jnum), 
                function(k)
                  all(abs(jnum[[k]] - csv[[k]]) < tol),
                logical(1)
                )
m_bps <- all(vapply(csv$partition_bps,
                    function(s) 
                      identical(bps, as.numeric(unlist(fromJSON(s, simplifyVector = FALSE)))),
                    logical(1))
             )
m_ibp <- all(vapply(csv$improvements_breakpoints,
                    function(s)
                      identical(ibp, as.numeric(unlist(fromJSON(s, simplifyVector = FALSE)))),
                    logical(1))
             )
m_dA <- all(vapply(csv$improvements_deltaAICc,
                   function(s)
                     all(abs(dA - fromJSON(s)) < tol),
                   logical(1))
            )
m_spos <- all(vapply(csv$site_positions,
                     function(s){ 
                     p<-fromJSON(s)
                     all(as.character(p) %in% names(sbps)) && length(p)==length(sbps) 
                     }, logical(1))
              )
m_ssup <- all(vapply(seq_len(nrow(csv)), function(i){
  p <- fromJSON(csv$site_positions[i])
  s <- fromJSON(csv$site_supports[i])
  js <- unlist(sbps[as.character(p)], use.names = FALSE)
  ##supports 1e-6 to 1e-149 , rel tol
  all(abs(js - s) <= 1e-9 * abs(js))          
  },
  logical(1))
  )
m_seq <- all(vapply(csv$sequence_names,
                     function(s) setequal(fromJSON(s), tips),
                    logical(1))
             )

####row-1 vals for display
d_bps <- as.numeric(unlist(fromJSON(csv$partition_bps[1], simplifyVector = FALSE)))
d_ibp <- as.numeric(unlist(fromJSON(csv$improvements_breakpoints[1], simplifyVector = FALSE)))
d_dA <- fromJSON(csv$improvements_deltaAICc[1])
d_sp <- as.integer(fromJSON(csv$site_positions[1]))
d_ss <- fromJSON(csv$site_supports[1])
d_seq <- fromJSON(csv$sequence_names[1])

##one json/csv/match row per gard-eh col (16)
cols <- c(names(jnum),
          "gene", "file_name", "partition_bps", "improvements_breakpoints",
          "improvements_deltaAICc", "site_positions", "site_supports", "sequence_names",
          "partition", "partition_nt_range")
json_v <- c(as.character(jnum),
            gene_exp, file_exp, toString(bps), toString(ibp), toString(dA),
            sprintf("%d sites [%d-%d]", length(sbps), min(jp), max(jp)),
            sprintf("%d supports", length(sbps)), sprintf("%d taxa", length(tips)),
            toString(as.integer(parts)), toString(json_rng))
csv_v <- c(as.character(unlist(csv[1, names(jnum)])),
           csv$gene[1], csv$file_name[1], toString(d_bps), toString(d_ibp), toString(d_dA),
           sprintf("%d sites [%d-%d]", length(d_sp), min(d_sp), max(d_sp)),
           sprintf("%d supports", length(d_ss)), sprintf("%d taxa", length(d_seq)),
           toString(csv$partition[ord]), toString(csv$partition_nt_range[ord]))
match_v<- c(m_num,
            all(csv$gene == gene_exp),
            all(csv$file_name == file_exp),
            m_bps, m_ibp, m_dA, m_spos, m_ssup, m_seq,
            setequal(csv$partition, as.integer(parts)) && length(csv$partition) == length(parts),
            all(csv$partition_nt_range[ord] == json_rng))

print(data.frame(column = cols, json = json_v, csv = csv_v, match = match_v),
      row.names = FALSE)

##clear on 16 gardeh cols

```


## fel checkin
```{r, fel checkin}

J <- fromJSON("FMO1_FEL.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("fmo1_felEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tol <- 1e-8

gene_exp <- sub("_.*", "", basename(J[["input"]][["file name"]]))
prog_exp <- sub("\\s.*", "", J[["analysis"]][["info"]])
###colname from json
hdr <- vapply(J$MLE$headers, `[[`, character(1), 1) 
ia <- match("alpha", hdr)
ib <- match("beta", hdr)
il <- match("LRT", hdr)
ip <- match("p-value", hdr)
mle <- J$MLE$content
parts <- names(mle)

###re-derive sig-site harvest from json per partition
hp <- function(p) {
  S <- mle[[p]]
  cov <- as.integer(unlist(J[["data partitions"]][[p]]$coverage))
  pos <- integer(0)
  om <- numeric(0)
  pv <- numeric(0)
  lr <- numeric(0)
  cls <- character(0)
  for (i in seq_along(S)) {
    s <- S[[i]]
    if (length(s) < 5) next
    a <- s[[ia]]
    w <- if (!is.null(a) && a!=0) s[[ib]]/a else NA_real_
    if (is.null(s[[ip]]) || is.na(w) || s[[ip]] > 0.05) next
    pos <- c(pos, if (length(cov) >= i) cov[i] else i)
    om <- c(om, w)
    pv <- c(pv, s[[ip]])
    lr <- c(lr, s[[il]])
    cls <- c(cls, if (w > 1) "positive" else "negative") }
  list(pos = pos, om = om, pv = pv, lr = lr, cls = cls, n_sites = length(S), n_sig = length(pos),
       n_pos = sum(cls == "positive"), n_neg = sum(cls == "negative"),
       rng = if (length(cov)) sprintf("%d-%d", min(cov), max(cov)) else "NA")
}
H <- lapply(parts, hp)
names(H) <- parts

pof <- function(i) as.character(csv$partition[i])
pp <- function(f) paste(vapply(parts, f, character(1)), collapse = ", ")
###FEL_site_classes has single quote
pclasses <- function(s) strsplit(gsub("[][' ]", "", s), ",")[[1]]     
cell <- function(col, p) csv[[col]][csv$partition == as.integer(p)][1]

## row builders -> column | json | csv | match, each checked over ALL rows
r_const <- function(col, exp) data.frame(column = col, json = exp, csv = csv[[col]][1], match = all(csv[[col]] == exp))
r_scalar <- function(col, key) data.frame(column = col, json = pp(function(p) as.character(H[[p]][[key]])),
              csv = pp(function(p) as.character(cell(col,p))),
              match = all(vapply(seq_len(nrow(csv)), 
                               function(i) isTRUE(csv[[col]][i] == H[[pof(i)]][[key]]), logical(1))))
###kind is int, num(abs tol), om(rel tol), cls
r_list <- function(col, key, kind) {
  d  <- function(v) if (!length(v)) "n0" else switch(kind,
          cls = sprintf("%dneg/%dpos", sum(v == "negative"), sum(v == "positive")),
          int = sprintf("n%d[%d-%d]", length(v), min(v), max(v)),
          sprintf("n%d[%s..%s]", length(v),
                  formatC(min(v), format = "g", digits = 3),
                  formatC(max(v), format = "g", digits = 3)))
  pr <- function(s) switch(kind, cls = pclasses(s),
                           int = as.integer(fromJSON(s)),
                           as.numeric(fromJSON(s)))
  eq <- function(a,b) switch(kind, cls = identical(a,as.character(b)), int = identical(a,as.integer(b)),
                             length(a) == length(b) && all(abs(a-b) <= (if (kind == "om") tol*abs(b) else tol)))
  data.frame(column = col, json = pp(function(p) d(H[[p]][[key]])), csv=pp(function(p) d(pr(cell(col,p)))),
             match = all(vapply(seq_len(nrow(csv)), function(i) eq(pr(csv[[col]][i]), H[[pof(i)]][[key]]), logical(1))))
}
###same style comparator type tables as prev 
print(rbind(
  r_const("gene_id", gene_exp), r_const("program", prog_exp), r_scalar("FEL_n_sites","n_sites"),
  r_scalar("FEL_n_significant","n_sig"), r_scalar("FEL_n_positive","n_pos"), r_scalar("FEL_n_negative","n_neg"),
  r_list("FEL_sig_sites","pos","int"), r_list("FEL_site_pvalues","pv","num"),
  r_list("FEL_site_omegas","om","om"), r_list("FEL_omega_coord","pos","int"),
  r_list("FEL_site_LRTs","lr","num"), r_list("FEL_LRTs_site","pos","int"),
  r_list("FEL_site_classes","cls","cls"),
  data.frame(column="branch_id", 
             json = pp(function(p) as.character(length(J[["branch attributes"]][[p]]))),
             csv = pp(function(p) as.character(sum(csv$partition == as.integer(p)))),
             match = all(vapply(parts, function(p){ 
               i <- csv$partition == as.integer(p)
               setequal(csv$branch_id[i], 
                        names(J[["branch attributes"]][[p]])) && sum(i) == length(J[["branch attributes"]][[p]]) 
               },
               logical(1)))
             ),
  data.frame(column = "partition", json = paste(as.integer(parts),collapse=", "),
             csv = paste(sort(unique(csv$partition)),collapse=", "),
             match = setequal(csv$partition, as.integer(parts)) && length(unique(csv$partition)) == length(parts)), r_scalar("partition_codon_range","rng")), row.names = FALSE)



```


## meme checkin
```{r, meme checkin}

##jf <- "FMO1_MEME.json"
## J <- fromJSON(jf, simplifyVector = FALSE)
##csv <- read.csv("fmo1_memeEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

jf <- "TSPO_MEME.json"
J <- fromJSON(jf, simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("tspo_memeEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tol <- 1e-8
n <- nrow(csv)

## header-anchored column resolution (normalize &alpha;/&beta;/markup, then match by name)
norm <- function(s) 
  tolower(trimws(gsub("<[^>]*>", "", gsub("&beta;" , "b", gsub("&alpha;", "a", s)))))
headernames <- vapply(J$MLE$headers, function(h) norm(h[[1]]), character(1))
ia <- match("a", headernames)
ibp <-match("b+", headernames)
il <- match("lrt", headernames)
ip <- match("p-value", headernames)
im <- match("meme logl", headernames)
gene_exp <- sub("_.*", "", basename(J[["input"]][["file name"]]))
file_exp <- basename(jf)
rng <- function(p){ 
  cov <- as.integer(unlist(J[["data partitions"]][[p]]$coverage))
  sprintf("%d-%d", min(cov), max(cov)) 
  }
gv <- function(rec,k) if (is.null(rec)) NULL else rec[[k]]

####per (part,branch); surviving sites (0-based) is p<=0.05 & a real sub on that branch
surv <- function(p,b){ 
  cont <- J$MLE$content[[p]]
  subs <- J$substitutions[[p]]
  keep <- integer(0)
  for (i in 0:(length(cont) - 1)){ 
    if (as.numeric(cont[[i + 1]][[ip]]) > 0.05) 
      next
    sv <- subs[[as.character(i)]]
    if (!is.null(sv) && !is.null(sv[[b]]) && sv[[b]] != "---")
      keep <- c(keep,i)} 
  keep
}
rcol <- function(p,s,idx) 
  if (length(s))
    vapply(s, function(i) 
      as.numeric(J$MLE$content[[p]][[i+1]][[idx]]),
      numeric(1))
else 
  numeric(0)
subbr <- function(p){
  o <- character(0)
  for (sv in J$substitutions[[p]])
    if (!is.null(sv))
      for (br in names(sv))
        if (!is.null(sv[[br]]) && sv[[br]] != "---")
          o <- c(o,br)
  unique(o)
}

###precompute every row json-side ref
RR <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i){
  p <- as.character(csv$partition[i])
  b <- csv$branch[i]
  s <- surv(p,b)
  rec <- J[["branch attributes"]][[p]][[b]]
  list(p = p, b = b, pos = s + 1, pv = rcol(p, s, ip), lr = rcol(p, s, il), al = rcol(p, s, ia), be = rcol(p, s, ibp),
       lg = rcol(p, s, im),
       sb = if(length(s))
         vapply(s, function(i) 
         J$substitutions[[p]][[as.character(i)]][[b]],
         character(1))
       else
         character(0),
       gmg = gv(rec, "Global MG94xREV"), ng = gv(rec,"Nucleotide GTR"), on = gv(rec,"original name")) 
  })

## comparators, parsers, bag-summariser (json & csv summarised identically)
neq <- function(a, b)
  length(a) == length(b) && all(abs(a-b) <= tol*pmax(1,abs(b)))
#### blank char read as "", treat as null
aok <- function(cv, ref){ 
  if (is.null(ref)) 
    return(is.na(cv) || cv == "")
  if (is.numeric(ref)) 
    return(!is.na(cv) && abs(as.numeric(cv) - ref) <= tol * max(1, abs(ref)))
  as.character(cv) == as.character(ref) }
pc  <- function(x, k)
  if (k == "str") 
    strsplit(gsub("[][' ]", "", x), ",")[[1]]
else if (k == "int")
  as.integer(fromJSON(x)) 
else as.numeric(fromJSON(x))
bs  <- function(v, k){
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if(!length(v))
    return("n0")
  if(k == "str"){
    u <- sort(unique(v))
    if(length(u) > 4) 
      u <- c(u[1:4], "...")
    return(sprintf("n%d{%s}", length(v), paste(substr(u, 1, 16), collapse = ","))) }
  if(k == "int") 
    return(sprintf("n%d[%d-%d]", length(v), min(v), max(v))) 
  sprintf("n%d[%s..%s]", length(v), formatC(min(v), format = "g", digits = 3), formatC(max(v), format = "g", digits=3))
  }

####row builder so, col,json,csv,match, as before for all in-rows
r_const <- function(col, val) 
  data.frame(column = col,
             json = as.character(val),
             csv = as.character(csv[[col]][1]),
             match = all(csv[[col]] == val))
r_list <- function(col, key, kind){
  cv <- lapply(seq_len(n),function(i) 
    pc(csv[[col]][i], kind))
  rf <- lapply(RR,`[[`,key)
  eq <- if(kind == "str") function(a, b) 
    identical(a, b) 
  else if(kind == "int")
    function(a, b) 
      identical(as.integer(a), as.integer(b)) else neq
  data.frame(column=col, json=bs(unlist(rf),kind), csv=bs(unlist(cv),kind), match=all(vapply(seq_len(n),function(i) eq(cv[[i]],rf[[i]]),logical(1)))) }
r_srow <- function(col,key,kind){ 
  rf<-lapply(RR,function(r){
    x <- r[[key]]
if(is.null(x)) NA else x})
  cb<-csv[[col]]
  if(kind == "str") 
    cb[cb == ""] <- NA
  data.frame(column = col,
             json = bs(unlist(rf), kind),
             csv = bs(cb, kind),
             match = all(vapply(seq_len(n), function(i)
               aok(csv[[col]][i],
                   RR[[i]][[key]]),
               logical(1))
               )
             ) 
  }

print(rbind(
  r_const("gene", gene_exp), r_const("json_file", file_exp),
  data.frame(column = "partition", json = paste(sort(as.integer(names(J$MLE$content))), collapse = ","),
             csv = paste(sort(unique(csv$partition)), collapse = ","),
             match = all(csv$partition %in% as.integer(names(J$MLE$content)))),
  data.frame(column = "partition_codon_range",
             json = paste(sort(unique(vapply(RR, function(r)
               rng(r$p),""))), collapse = ","),
             csv = paste(sort(unique(csv$partition_codon_range)), collapse = ","),
             match = all(vapply(seq_len(n),
                                function(i)
                                  csv$partition_codon_range[i] == rng(RR[[i]]$p),
                                logical(1)
                                )
                         )
             ),
  data.frame(column = "branch", json = sprintf("%d valid", n), csv = sprintf("%d branches", length(unique(csv$branch))),
             match = all(vapply(seq_len(n),
                                function(i) 
                                  RR[[i]]$b %in% names(J[["branch attributes"]][[RR[[i]]$p]]) || RR[[i]]$b %in% subbr(RR[[i]]$p),
                                logical(1)
                                )
                         )
             ),
  r_srow("Global_MG94xREV","gmg","num"), r_srow("Nucleotide_GTR","ng","num"), r_srow("original_name","on","str"),
  r_list("site_positions","pos","int"), r_list("site_pval","pv","num"), r_list("site_LRT","lr","num"),
  r_list("site_alpha","al","num"), r_list("site_beta_plus","be","num"), r_list("site_MEMElogl","lg","num"),
  r_list("site_substitution","sb","str")), row.names = FALSE)

### no pos sites in part0 so part1 is TRUE in partition col; only pos is codon 369 (tspo)

```


## fubar checkin
```{r, fubar checkin}

###J <- fromJSON("FMO1_FUBAR.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
###csv <- read.csv("fmo1_fubarEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

J <- fromJSON("TSPO_FUBAR.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("tspo_fubarEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

tol <- 1e-8
n <- nrow(csv)
####header anchor to catch any drifting index mismatch against header (hdr)
hdr <- vapply(J$MLE$headers, function(h) h[[1]], character(1))
ia <- match("alpha", hdr)
ib <- match("beta", hdr)
iba <- match("beta-alpha", hdr)
ipg <- match("Prob[alpha>beta]", hdr)
ipl <- match("Prob[alpha<beta]", hdr)
ibf <- match("BayesFactor[alpha<beta]", hdr)
###json input sllot ref
gene_exp <- sub("_.*", "", basename(J[["input"]][["file name"]]))
info <- J$analysis$info
####acronym yank from analysis.info
prog_exp <- gsub("[()]", "", regmatches(info, regexpr("\\([A-Za-z-]+\\)", info)))  
parts <- names(J$MLE$content)
ba <- J[["branch attributes"]]
rng <- function(p){
  cov <- as.integer(unlist(J[["data partitions"]][[p]]$coverage))
  sprintf("%d-%d", min(cov), max(cov))
  }

####per partition harvest; site lvl, identical across branches); sig site prob thresh is 0.9!
sig  <- function(p){ 
  M <- J$MLE$content[[p]]
  keep <- integer(0)
  for (i in 0:(length(M) - 1)){
    r <- M[[i + 1]]
    pg <- r[[ipg]]
    pl <- r[[ipl]]
    if ((is.numeric(pg) && pg >= 0.9) || (is.numeric(pl) && pl >= 0.9)) 
      keep <- c(keep, i) 
    }
  keep
  }
hcol <- function(p, s, idx) 
  if(length(s)) vapply(s, function(i) 
    as.numeric(J$MLE$content[[p]][[i + 1]][[idx]]),
    numeric(1))
else 
  numeric(0)
H <- lapply(parts, function(p){
  s <- sig(p)
  list(sites = s + 1, al = hcol(p, s, ia), be = hcol(p, s, ib), ba = hcol(p, s, iba),
     pg = hcol(p, s, ipg), pl = hcol(p, s, ipl), bf = hcol(p, s, ibf)) })
names(H) <- parts

neq <- function(a, b) length(a) == length(b) && all(abs(a - b) <= tol*pmax(1,abs(b)))
pof <- function(i) as.character(csv$partition[i])
pc  <- function(x, k) if(k == "int") as.integer(fromJSON(x)) else as.numeric(fromJSON(x))
bg  <- function(v, k){ 
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if(!length(v)) 
    return("n0")
  if(k == "int")
    sprintf("n%d[%d-%d]", length(v), min(v), max(v))
  else 
    sprintf("n%d[%s..%s]", length(v), formatC(min(v), format = "g", digits = 3),
            formatC(max(v), format = "g", digits = 3)
            )
  }

####builders; col,json , csv, match, same as above....
r_const <- function(col, val)
  data.frame(column = col, json = as.character(val),
             csv = as.character(csv[[col]][1]), match = all(csv[[col]] == val))
r_pc <- function(col, key, kind){
  ####site col per partition
  eq <- if(kind == "int") function(a, b) identical(as.integer(a), as.integer(b)) else neq
  cellp <- function(p)
    pc(csv[[col]][csv$partition == as.integer(p)][1], kind)
  data.frame(column = col, json = paste(vapply(parts, function(p) 
    bg(H[[p]][[key]], kind), ""), collapse = ", "),
             csv = paste(vapply(parts, function(p) 
               bg(cellp(p), kind), ""), collapse = ", "),
             match = all(vapply(seq_len(n),function(i) 
               eq(pc(csv[[col]][i], kind), H[[pof(i)]][[key]]), logical(1)))) 
  }
branch_ok <- vapply(seq_len(n),function(i){ 
  p <- pof(i)
  b <- csv$branch[i]
  b %in% names(ba[[p]]) && b == (if(!is.null(ba[[p]][[b]][["original name"]]))
    ba[[p]][[b]][["original name"]] 
    else b
    ) 
  }, logical(1))
gtrref <- vapply(seq_len(n),function(i){
  g <- ba[[pof(i)]][[csv$branch[i]]][["Nucleotide GTR"]]
  if(is.null(g)) 
    NA_real_
  else g
  },
  numeric(1))
####print out the comp/validation content
print(rbind(r_const("gene", gene_exp), r_const("program", prog_exp),
            data.frame(column = "partition", json = paste(sort(as.integer(parts)), collapse = ","),
                       csv = paste(sort(unique(csv$partition)), collapse = ","),
                       match = all(csv$partition %in% as.integer(parts))),
            data.frame(column = "partition_codon_range", json = paste(vapply(parts, rng, ""), collapse = ", "),
                       csv = paste(sort(unique(csv$partition_codon_range)), collapse = ", "),
                       match = all(vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) 
                         csv$partition_codon_range[i] == rng(pof(i)), logical(1)))),
            data.frame(column = "branch", json = sprintf("%d rows",n), 
                       csv = sprintf("%d valid/%d uniq",sum(branch_ok), length(unique(csv$branch))),match=all(branch_ok)),
            data.frame(column = "GTR", json = bg(gtrref,"num"), csv = bg(csv$GTR,"num"),
                       match = all(vapply(seq_len(n), function(i){
                         g <- ba[[pof(i)]][[csv$branch[i]]][["Nucleotide GTR"]]
                         !is.null(g)&&abs(as.numeric(csv$GTR[i]) - g) <= tol * max(1,abs(g))
                         },
                         logical(1))
                         )
                       ),
            r_pc("sites", "sites", "int"), r_pc("alpha", "al", "num"), r_pc("beta", "be", "num"),
            r_pc("beta-alpha", "ba", "num"), r_pc("Prob[alpha>beta]", "pg", "num"), r_pc("Prob[alpha<beta]", "pl", "num"),
            r_pc("BayesFactor[alpha<beta]", "bf", "num")
            ),
      row.names = FALSE
      )
```

## absrel checkin
```{r, absrel checkin}

####jf <- "FMO1part1_aBSREL.json"
###J <- fromJSON("FMO1part1_aBSREL.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
###csv <- read.csv("fmo1_absrelp1EH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

jf <- "TSPOpart1_aBSREL.json"
J <- fromJSON(jf, simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("tspopart1_absrelEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tol <- 1e-8
n <- nrow(csv)
###filename carve out (this is also how the harvester takes it)
gene_exp <- sub("_aBSREL\\.json$", "", basename(jf)) 
###first token of analysis.info, aBSREL, altho harvester actually takes this from fname too
prog_exp <- sub("\\s.*", "", J$analysis$info) 
####single partition key w/in split file
ba <- J[["branch attributes"]][["0"]]                               
species <- function(bid){
  p <- strsplit(bid,"_")[[1]]
  if (length(p) > 1) p[2]
  else
    "NA" 
  }
maxo <- function(bs){
  rd <- bs[["Rate Distributions"]]
  if(!length(rd))
    return(NA_real_)
  max(vapply(rd, function(x)
    as.numeric(x[[1]]), numeric(1))
  )}

####branches to be kept; has lrt, p at 0.05 thresh, max omega class > 1
kept <- Filter(
  function(bid){
    bs <- ba[[bid]]
    pc <- bs[["Corrected P-value"]]
    pu <- bs[["Uncorrected P-value"]]
    pv <- if(!is.null(pc)) pc else pu
    mo <- maxo(bs) 
    !is.null(bs[["LRT"]]) && !is.null(pv) && pv <= 0.05 && !is.na(mo) && mo > 1 
    }, 
  names(ba)
  )

## per selected-branch references
RR <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i){
  bid <- csv$branch_id[i]
  bs <- ba[[bid]]
  rd <- bs[["Rate Distributions"]]
  oms <- vapply(rd, function(x) as.numeric(x[[1]]), numeric(1))
  wts <- vapply(rd, function(x) as.numeric(x[[2]]), numeric(1))
  dN <- bs[["Full adaptive model (non-synonymous subs/site)"]]
  dS <- bs[["Full adaptive model (synonymous subs/site)"]]
  pc <- bs[["Corrected P-value"]]
  pu <- bs[["Uncorrected P-value"]]
  list(bid = bid, LRT = bs[["LRT"]], pv = if(!is.null(pc)) pc else pu,
       pc = pc, pu = pu, dN = dN, dS = dS,
       bo = if(!is.null(dN) && !is.null(dS) && dS != 0) dN/dS else NULL,
       bom = bs[["Baseline MG94xREV omega ratio"]], blnl = bs[["Baseline MG94xREV"]],
       gtr = bs[["Nucleotide GTR"]], rc = bs[["Rate classes"]], oms = oms,
       wts = wts, po = oms[oms > 1], pw = wts[oms > 1], 
       mo = if(length(oms)) max(oms) else NA_real_) 
  })

neq <- function(a, b) length(a) == length(b) && all(abs(a - b) <= tol * pmax(1, abs(b)))
sc  <- function(cv, ref){ 
  if(is.null(ref))
    return(is.na(cv) || cv == "")
  !is.na(cv) && abs(as.numeric(cv) - as.numeric(ref)) <= tol * max(1, abs(as.numeric(ref))) 
  }
pl <- function(x){
  v <- fromJSON(x)
  if(length(v) == 0) 
    numeric(0) 
  else as.numeric(v)
  }
bg <- function(v, k){
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if(!length(v))
    return("n0")
  if(k == "str")
    return(paste(sort(unique(v)), collapse = ","))
  sprintf("n%d[%s..%s]", length(v), 
          formatC(min(v), format = "g", digits = 3),
          formatC(max(v), format = "g", digits = 3)
          ) 
  }

#### as in prev blocks... col, json, csv, match
r_const <- function(col, val) data.frame(column = col, json = as.character(val),
                                        csv = as.character(csv[[col]][1]), 
                                        match = all(csv[[col]] == val))
###per branchh scalar
r_sb <- function(col, key){
  bag <- vapply(RR, function(r){
    x <- r[[key]]
    if(is.null(x)) 
      NA_real_ 
    else as.numeric(x)},
    numeric(1)
    )
  data.frame(column = col, json = bg(bag, "num"),
             csv = bg(csv[[col]], "num"), 
             match = all(vapply(seq_len(n),
                                function(i) 
                                  sc(csv[[col]][i],
                                     RR[[i]][[key]]),
                                logical(1)
                                ))
  ) 
}
#### per branch rate class list
r_lb <- function(col, key) data.frame(column = col, 
                                      json = bg(unlist(lapply(RR, `[[`, key)), "num"),
                                      csv = bg(unlist(lapply(seq_len(n),
                                                             function(i)
                                                               pl(csv[[col]][i]))),"num"),
                                      match = all(vapply(seq_len(n),
                                                         function(i) 
                                                           neq(pl(csv[[col]][i]),
                                                               RR[[i]][[key]]), 
                                                         logical(1)
                                                         )
                                                  )
                                      )
#####and now the print out ( col, json, csv, match)..
print(rbind(r_const("gene_id", gene_exp), r_const("program", prog_exp),
            data.frame(column = "branch_id", json = sprintf("%d selected", length(kept)),
                       csv = sprintf("%d rows", n), match = setequal(csv$branch_id, kept)),
            data.frame(column = "species", json = bg(vapply(RR, function(r) species(r$bid), ""), "str"),
                       csv = paste(sort(unique(ifelse(is.na(csv$species), "NA", csv$species))), collapse = ","),
                       match = all(vapply
                                   (seq_len(n), function(i){
                                    e <- species(csv$branch_id[i])
                                    if(e == "NA") 
                                      is.na(csv$species[i]) || csv$species[i] == "NA"
                                    else !is.na(csv$species[i]) && csv$species[i] == e },
                                     logical(1)
                                     )
                                   )
                       ),
            r_sb("aBSREL_LRT", "LRT"), r_sb("aBSREL_pvalue", "pv"), r_sb("aBSREL_pvalue_corrected", "pc"),
            r_sb("aBSREL_pvalue_uncorrected", "pu"), r_sb("aBSREL_branch_dN", "dN"), r_sb("aBSREL_branch_dS", "dS"),
            r_sb("aBSREL_branch_omega", "bo"), r_sb("aBSREL_baseline_omega", "bom"), r_sb("aBSREL_baseline_lnL", "blnl"),
            r_sb("aBSREL_nucleotide_GTR", "gtr"), r_sb("aBSREL_rate_classes", "rc"), r_lb("aBSREL_omega_classes", "oms"),
            r_lb("aBSREL_omega_weights", "wts"), r_lb("aBSREL_positive_omega_classes", "po"), r_lb("aBSREL_positive_omega_weights", "pw"),
            r_sb("aBSREL_max_omega", "mo")
            ),
      row.names = FALSE
      )
```
